field: S02 S-II gamma .21–.22 despite .254 mm precision
independent_value: Own skew-corrected graph reading gives .20991/.22226, approximately ±.01, at R/rho≈241. CR-1457 refers to S-II development tests, with plasticity corrections and thermal-gradient qualifications. No matched shape/buckling dataset is available here.
basis: sources/cr1457-fig623.png; RESULTS.json sensitivities.SII_digitization

field: S04 Rohr 57 in: .050 in after forming, .150–.200 after milling
owner_value: Rohr 57 in: .050 in after forming, .150–.200 after milling
independent_value: The values are supported, but are residual contour errors before extensive hand forming to the welding jig. The report also describes a final creep-sizing tensile failure. They are not achieved final bulkhead precision. Conversions are 1.27 and 3.81–5.08 mm.
basis: sources/009-ntrs66014454.txt PDF pp.3–4,25

field: S06 Ares I weld mismatch ≤.041 in
independent_value: The .041 in value is the magnitude of the maximum post-tack effective mismatch on CBMDA #1, approximately 20% of its weld land thickness. It is not a demonstrated final shape tolerance; the subsequent full weld had PAUT indications.
basis: sources/008-ntrs20120014602.txt Table 2

field: S10 ALMA 38 µm laser →55 µm holography→14 µm
owner_value: ALMA 38 µm laser →55 µm holography→14 µm
independent_value: Values occur, but an intervening hard-stop accident led to a repeat laser measurement of 50 µm before 55 µm holography. Two full and one partial adjustments reached about 14 µm; later evaluation gives 16–17 µm. The sequence is not a pure instrument comparison.
basis: sources/030-alma_proto.txt §5.1.1

independent_value: The 98 µm overall optical RMS is supported. ≤20 µm applies to recent outer-ring segments; some inner segments remain 30–40 µm and 11 ring-4 segments require improvement. The claim cannot cover every segment.
basis: sources/033-lmt_hughes.txt PDF pp.7–8,13–14

field: S17 Moss R18.3 m held <2 cm; JUNO ±50 mm; JT-60SA ±8 mm
owner_value: Moss R18.3 m held <2 cm; JUNO ±50 mm; JT-60SA ±8 mm
independent_value: Moss <2 cm is a required deviation, not a demonstrated final-shell bound in the cited sentence. JUNO ±50 mm is a diameter requirement; panels require <6 mm deviation. JT-60SA ±8 mm is a specified spherical-radius tolerance. They are not interchangeable measured RMS values.
basis: sources/076-isprs-faig-1980.txt p.1; sources/074-arxiv-juno-cd-2311.17314.txt p.27; sources/077-jt60sa-cryostat.txt

field: S21 345 MPa gives a 1.19e-3 elastic limit
independent_value: 345/E=1.189655e-3 is the elastic strain component at a tensile proof/yield proxy, not a measured proportional limit or compression forming allowable. The listed 4.645152e-4 strain gives Eε=134.709408 MPa; 67.354704 MPa needs half that strain or another stated model.
basis: RESULTS.json route and sensitivities; intake/upstream/028b-METHOD.md

field: S22 AF163-2U's own verified 200 F/6 h cure
owner_value: AF163-2U's own verified 200 F/6 h cure
independent_value: The sheet says limited family-level results suggest useful performance at 200 F/6 h. Its numerical 200 F metal-to-metal table is AF163-2K .06 lb/ft² at 50 psi, not U .015 on this core/Be. A supplier process qualification remains open.
basis: sources/072-3m-af163-2.txt sections V and VI

field: S24 A stress-free temperature above 54 C is the threshold
owner_value: A stress-free temperature above 54 C is the threshold
independent_value: The 54 C threshold in 037b concerns the separate 037 floated point. 028b's 30:1 scarf already binds at nominal load; positive added compression has no spare scarf margin.
basis: intake/upstream/035/CARD.md sections 1,2 and residual state

field: S26 028b closes with 2 kg to spare
independent_value: The selected 028b charged-total mass equals lift within numerical roundoff. Unallocated margin is approximately zero; its fixed reserve is already assigned. The 2 kg statement is not supported by the pinned point.
basis: RESULTS.json sensitivities.mass_residual_at_028b_kg; intake/upstream/004/RESULTS.json

field: S27 43.4 kg trapped air in this 23.2 mm core
owner_value: 43.4 kg trapped air in this 23.2 mm core
independent_value: 034 used a 30.1182 mm core. At 028b, even a completely void thin-shell core contains at most 34.0851 kg at the specified 500 m atmosphere; a finite annulus with the stated solid fraction gives 33.7988 kg. Ground sea-level full-void upper estimate is 35.7709 kg.
basis: RESULTS.json sensitivities.trapped_core_air; intake/upstream/012/CARD.md

independent_value: The value reproduces a first-order unconstrained local membrane estimate. Keeping the exact 1/(1−gauge_fraction) dependence gives 1.40410 mm before compatibility effects. Therefore 1.22 is not established as an upper bound.

owner_value: Eq.3 values near .90–.95 from small fabrication errors
independent_value: The inverses/forward values reproduce, but .15/.254/1.27 mm examples are below d/t=.07, excluded from the fit's small-amplitude behavior. A monolithic-shell fit transferred through equivalent thickness does not validate sandwich buckling.
basis: sources/baizhikova2026.txt Eq.3; RESULTS.json precedent_dimples

independent_value: Table 4 full cumulative logit values are 41.8 and 29 mm. 43.3/28 remove best and worst inspectors. The worst manual fit did not converge; worst automated is 70 mm. Test panels have .5 mm Al skins, 19 mm panel thickness, 4.76 mm cells and 91 kg/m³ core.
basis: sources/087-icaf2023-genest-tap.txt Table 4 and test-panel description

independent_value: The inferred coefficients are 4.198 and 14.682. Solving the circular-plate boundary equations at Be nu=.0752 gives k=3.600503 and 14.681971, hence 27.127598 and 54.779991 mm. field: S45 Profiler .4 µm repeatability means yes for .075 mm waviness
owner_value: Profiler .4 µm repeatability means yes for .075 mm waviness
independent_value: The current LJ-X8060 page confirms .4 µm Z repeatability but separately specifies linearity and temperature effects. Repeatability is not accuracy or an installed-surface acceptance capability.
basis: sources/keyence-current.html; public page checked 2026-10-20

field: S47 Fibre sensing .65 mm pitch, ±5 µε
independent_value: The Luna sheet distinguishes measurement uncertainty from system accuracy: the .65 mm-pitch column has ±5 µε uncertainty but ±25 µε system accuracy. Pitch availability also depends on the 610x/600x mode. It is not full-field shape data.
basis: sources/163-luna-odisi6000.txt specification table and notes 6–7

field: S48 OSHA .2 µg/m³ therefore every scarf must be supplier-cut
owner_value: OSHA .2 µg/m³ therefore every scarf must be supplier-cut
independent_value: The .2 value is an 8-hour TWA; the 15-minute STEL is 2.0 µg/m³. Controls and regulated-area criteria depend on exposure. Supplier-only cutting is the proposed process choice, not a categorical location requirement in this rule.
basis: official public rule checked 2026-10-20, paragraphs (b),(c),(e),(f)

field: S52 Published gamma/Q map supports .2 / about .6
independent_value: The arithmetic is a projection. The historical .2 handbook design factor, isolated defect maps and reflector RMS do not establish any measured installed P2 gamma or Q. Qualified values remain null.
